description: Item, area, NPC and mission definitions and interactables that the Unreal runtime actually uses. Mirrors MarburgumIIShared/Public/MarburgumGameplayContract.h, scripts/editor/create_net_smoke_map.py and scripts/editor/create_lent_map.py; scripts/validate-gameplay-contract.py keeps them in step.

provenance.note: Identifier and English name carried forward; no legacy code or asset.
Registered because lent_first_catch stage 1 requires an ordinary fish; nothing in this build grants one (fishing is Stage 2).

interactables.note: Development fixture for Gate 1: a limited, server-owned stock shared by every player. Not authored Marburgum content.
Placed 25 m from every player start to prove the server's range check.

dialogue.en: The Drava looks calm from here, but the current does the real work. Keep your first casts close to the bank.

provenance.note: Id, name, position (height levelled to the blockout promenade), range, dialogue and parka colours carried forward; placeholder figure, not a character model.

world_store.adapter: development JSON file per map, atomic replace (ADR-014); schema 2 adds per-character missions and typed receipts; schema 3 adds per-character condition (ADR-020)

provenance.source: original Marburgum src/shared/combat.h (DEFAULT_VITALITY, DEFAULT_STAMINA, RUN_DRAIN_PER_SECOND, STAMINA_RECOVERY_PER_SECOND, RUN_RESUME_STAMINA) and src/shared/protocol.h (WALK_SPEED, RUN_SPEED); body save/restore in src/server/world_simulation.cpp
provenance.review: Running and its breath cost carried forward; vitality is stored and shown but nothing in this build changes it yet (falls, drowning and fights are not implemented).

provenance.note: Box carried forward in the original coordinate frame (x east, y up, z south of the middle of Stari most); music not carried.

summary.en: An ordinary Fishing assignment on the Drava has turned into a trail of old records, addresses and people.

objective_text.en: Catch one ordinary fish from the nearby Drava spot, then show it to the riverside angler.
Inspect the debris beside the Drava and pull out the battered metal cashbox.

provenance.note: Stages 1-2 of 5 registered. Stage 1 cannot complete until fishing exists; the stage 2 debris is not placed. Stage grant items and the 50-money reward are not carried yet.
